<tab id="GeneralTab" data-l10n-id="folder-props-general-tab" />
          <tab id="Retention" data-l10n-id="retention-tab" />
          <tab
            id="SynchronizationTab"
            data-l10n-id="folder-props-synchronization-tab"
            hidefor="pop3,rss,none"
          />
          <tab
            id="SharingTab"
            data-l10n-id="folder-props-sharing-tab"
            hidefor="pop3,rss,none,nntp,ews"
          />
          <tab
            id="QuotaTab"
            data-l10n-id="folder-props-quota-tab"
            hidefor="pop3,rss,none,nntp,ews"
          />
        </tabs>
        <tabpanels id="folderPropTabPanels">
          <vbox id="GeneralPanel">
            <hbox id="nameBox" align="center" class="input-container">
              <label
                id="nameLabel"
                data-l10n-id="folder-props-name"
                control="name"
              />
              <hbox align="center" class="input-container">
                <html:input
                  id="name"
                  type="text"
                  readonly="readonly"
                  oninput="doEnabling()"
                  class="input-inline"
                  aria-labelledby="nameLabel"
                />
                <label
                  id="colorLabel"
                  data-l10n-id="folder-props-color"
                  control="color"
                />
                <html:input
                  id="color"
                  type="color"
                  value=""
                  class="input-inline-color"
                  aria-labelledby="colorLabel"
                />
                <button
                  id="resetColor"
                  data-l10n-id="folder-props-reset-color"
                  class="toolbarbutton-1 btn-flat btn-reset"
                />
              </hbox>
              <label
                id="locationLabel"
                data-l10n-id="folder-props-location"
                control="location"
              />
              <html:input
                id="location"
                type="text"
                readonly="readonly"
                class="uri-element input-inline"
                aria-labelledby="locationLabel"
              />
            </hbox>
            <vbox>
              <spacer height="2" />
              <hbox align="center">
                <label data-l10n-id="folder-props-number-of-messages" />
                <label
                  id="numberOfMessages"
                  data-l10n-id="folder-props-number-unknown"
                />
                <spacer flex="1" />
                <label data-l10n-id="folder-props-size-on-disk" />
                <label
                  id="sizeOnDisk"
                  data-l10n-id="folder-props-size-unknown"
                />
              </hbox>
              <spacer height="2" />
            </vbox>
            <checkbox
              id="folderIncludeInGlobalSearch"
              data-l10n-id="folder-props-include-in-global-search"
              hidefor="nntp"
            />
            <checkbox
              id="folderCheckForNewMessages"
              data-l10n-id="folder-props-check-for-new-messages"
              hidefor="pop3,none,nntp"
            />
            <separator class="thin" />
            <hbox>
              <description
                id="folderRebuildSummaryExplanation"
                data-l10n-id="folder-props-rebuild-summary-explanation"
                flex="1"
              ></description>
              <vbox>
                <button
                  id="folderRebuildSummaryButton"
                  data-l10n-id="folder-props-rebuild-summary"
                  oncommand="RebuildSummaryInformation(event)"
                  align="center"
                />
